notes.title: Big update: Space, colonization of a new planet and mutations
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510288/898149c038fed52e9cb8d4bd780ecbc735eb1aa4.png[/img]
Space is a pretty big update, though, it's for players who have completed the latest content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510288/3415fe0b7d1a75d258e9ba0e7a0fd23f0659d20a.png[/img]
Space can be opened when all empires are fully upgraded. In order to achieve this you will have to play for a long time probably. But the content of the previous version would end after the upgrading of all empires, and it bothered me. So I added more endgame content.

Space has its own interface and map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510288/667ffad71d557bdb9847deefc2c15ef76227dce5.png[/img]

New sectors can be opened for energy. This is like buying tiles with gold in the main game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510288/42c796a76e7a9a7b6b60924145751df8513bdd82.png[/img]

The result of space development is the creation of a colonization ship. The ship goes to a new planet... and everything starts all over again :)

[b]But the colonization of the planet gives bonuses:[/b][list][*] You can choose 2 mutations. These are special improvements that can have a significant impact on the gameplay.
[*]You will get 100% more empire points.
[/list]

[b]Examples of mutations:[/b][list][*]+500 workers in the first building built.
[*]+2 gold per second, international trade is immediately open.
[*]Once for abdication you can change god. The holiness is preserved (for example, you can gain a lot of holiness from the chicken and then switch to oni).
[*]x4 wheat and wood production (trivial, but pretty good).
[/list]

[b]All mutations:[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34510288/10cc00c678718916c6d5d670c0f78e0becdb34e0.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 160 and 160r
notes.notes:
Game updated! This update isn't very big and contains mostly bugfixes. I wanted to fix these bugs before I started making a big content update.

[b]Version 160[/b]
[list]
[*] The second axe did not increase the speed of the battle (from forge upgrade)
[*] The ships received from the mysteries were not taken into account when sailing away
[*] Fixed some glitches with the hero
[*] Fixed offline hiring for caves (stone trial)
[/list]

[b]Version 160r[/b]
It's a special update. Some players have a rare bug with overlapping tiles. This is why there is a "restore tiles" button in the menu. Previously, the tiles recovery algorithm tried to preserve the shape of the continent, which you create by choosing places for tiles, but because of this the recovery did not always work. Now it always works, but the arrangement of tiles before the recovery is not taken into account (in any case, it makes sense to use this button only when the bug with overlapping).

notes.title: Ver. 159 (Bugfixes, Early Acess thoughts)
notes.notes:
Game updated! This update fixes a lot of bugs as well as some text mistakes.

(1) More accurate display of HP, armor and damage if the numbers are large
(2) Mistakes/typos in text fixed
(3) Capture tiles achievement fixed
(4) Russia 5 empire perk fixed
(5) Relic page bug with Wise Frog god selected
(6) Frog trial +200% hero exp bug fixed
(7) Divine trials can no longer be repeated (otherwise bugs occurred)

I also think it's time for the game to get out of early access. It won't mean I'll stop adding new content, or fix bugs (if there are any ːsteammockingːːsteammockingː). 
But I don't think the mechanics of the game will change globally anymore. So in a week or two, I think the game will come out.

notes.title: Big update (New god, new nations!)
notes.notes:
New god added!
[h1]WISE FROG[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34510288/1753fa6f692908b4db9ffde4c2f80fde737dbe23.png[/img]
[b]Quest for knowledge[/b]
+20% school effect
+20% to hero experience

[b]Quest for glory[/b]
+200% school effect
+200% to hero experience

[b]Quest for mysteries[/b]
Creates a mystery on a random tile. (This tile should not contain a mystery.) On the tile with the mystery, a worker appears for free every 25 min (this can be upgraded).
(For academy: the hero gets 3 AAP every 25 min)
(For forge: +1 fuel every 25 min)
(For training hall, hotel: +1 training, +1 rest every 25 min)

Mysteries give +1 holiness per second.
Each mystery gives +10% to gold when abdicating.

[i]To choose a new god, you have to hire a great prophet (great people appear when you sail away from the first continent).[/i]

[h1]New nations added.[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34510288/dc3c40024681a7b59b4d98e68f8fceeca8f74f1d.png[/img]
These new nations will be unlocked when you spend enough empire points.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34510288/aa1728ac2fb9d4fade8026c5b79081d65b641805.png[/img]

[b]English[/b]
[list]
[*] Adds a new bow to the hero's weapon. This bow will be available from the first level. (+30 damage, +30 evasion chance, +3HP and +3 evasion chance per kill if hero is not tired).
[*] BUILDING UPGRADE: Shipyard -> Royal Dockyard. Royal dockyard acts like a shipyard but the ships cost 20% less.
[*] +1 gold from every ship.
[*] When buying a coastal tile, 80% of the gold spent on this tile is returned.
[*] When fighting for a coastal tile, each ship gives +1 HP to hero. (Will not work in the very first battle).
[/list]


[b]Chineese[/b]
[list]
[*] +1 wheat from wheat worker, +1 wood from logger, +1 stone from mason
[*] BUILDING UPGRADE: Temple -> Pagoda. The pagoda acts like a temple, but monks are 2 times cheaper.
[*] Pagodas do not require a stone to be built.
[*] Heroes block 1 point of damage.
[*] 2x effect from mentorship and mentorship costs 25% less gold.
[/list]


[b]German[/b]
[list]
[*] Heroes start at level 2.
[*] BUILDING UPGRADE: Quarry -> Mining Camp. Mining camp acts like a quarry. When abdicating, each mine gives +500 wheat, wood, stone and gold for the next game.
[*] When abdicating, each mine gives +500 faith.
[*] Clearing the tile costs 3 amber cheaper (i.e. the first clearing will be free).
[*] After abdication you can restore all buildings by paying 5 million gold. Buildings are restored without workers. Buildings can be restored only if you have not built anything yet.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Updated (New pantheon, bugfixes, panheon improvements)
notes.notes:
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
* Fixed errors in the text.
* Fixed a bug with an error at the beginning of the game (LandBattle)
* Added error screen, which is shown if the game was completed with an error.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34510288/f091bb2c69f5c431e3fd95ada65957b881c5d6cc.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34510288/f18f57a6fe934e5f4566111f48115c86ed14a6e1.png[/img][/url]


[h1]New pantheon: Religious settlements[/h1]
Allows you to customize the auto-hiring ritual, without a special relic. 
You can specify tiles for which auto-hiring ritual will not work. 
+300 seconds to ritual duration, if ONLY the auto-hiring ritual is performed.
50% hiring time for all workers.


[h1]Pantheon improvements[/h1]
[b]Handwashing[/b]
+30 seconds to ritual duration
+3 to rituals automation (was +1)

[b]God of the open sky[/b]
+1 wheat per worker on the wheat fields
5x hiring speed for workers on wheat fields
2x hiring speed for farmers (new)

[b]Legends of the forest[/b]
+1 wood per worker in forest camps
10x hiring speed for workers in the forest (was 5x)
Forest camp doesn’t require wood to be built

[h1]Future plans[/h1]
Next, I want to work on new empire bonuses.
